headline: China Pushes Domestic Oil Production as Middle East Supplies Tighten
summary: China's National Energy Administration has called on PetroChina, Sinopec, and CNOOC to expand domestic production and exploration as supply disruptions from the Iran conflict constrain imports.
why: Energy security is paramount for major industrial economies, prompting state directives to ramp up domestic fossil fuel extraction when geopolitical shocks occur.

impacts.name: PetroChina
impacts.why: State-directed domestic drilling increases operating activity for national oil companies.
